name: table

files.content: {@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { BodyProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: BodyProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Body rows. -->
<tbody class={["tableBody", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</tbody>

<style>
	/* The last row drops its border so it does not double the table edge */
	.tableBody :global(tr:last-child) {
		border-bottom: 0;
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { CaptionProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: CaptionProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Title of the table, announced with it and shown under the rows. -->
<caption class={["tableCaption", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</caption>

<style>
	/* Base caption; padding instead of a gap, since a caption is not a flex item */
	.tableCaption {
		padding-top: var(--spacing-lg);
		color: var(--muted-foreground);
	}
</style>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { FooterProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: FooterProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Summary rows on a muted background. -->
<tfoot class={["tableFooter", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</tfoot>

<style>
	/* Base footer */
	.tableFooter {
		border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
		background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 50%, transparent);
		font-weight: 500;
	}

	.tableFooter :global(tr:last-child) {
		border-bottom: 0;
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { HeadProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: HeadProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Column heading; set `scope` when a heading labels a row instead of a column. -->
<th class={["tableHead", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</th>

<style>
	/* Base heading; the height and padding come from the size on the table */
	.tableHead {
		vertical-align: middle;
		padding-inline: var(--table-cell-padding);
		height: var(--table-head-height);
		color: var(--foreground);
		font-weight: 500;
		text-align: left;
		white-space: nowrap;
	}

	/* A checkbox column stays narrow */
	.tableHead:has(:global([role="checkbox"])) {
		padding-right: 0;
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { HeaderProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: HeaderProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Header rows, divided from the body by a border. -->
<thead class={["tableHeader", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</thead>

<style>
	/* Every header row keeps its bottom border */
	.tableHeader :global(tr) {
		border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { RowProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: RowProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- One row; highlighted on hover and while `data-state="selected"`. -->
<tr class={["tableRow", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</tr>

<style>
	/* Base row */
	.tableRow {
		transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
		border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
	}

	.tableRow:hover {
		background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 50%, transparent);
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Selected row */
	.tableRow[data-state="selected"] {
		background-color: var(--muted);
	}
</style>

description: A responsive data table with a header, body, footer, rows, cells, a caption, and sizes.
